dutyRateBasis: Canada HS 9405.11.00 (electric lighting fittings designed for LED) / 9405.19.00 (other), MFN column, 7%. Canada applies no Section 301 equivalent to these goods - its surtaxes on Chinese imports cover electric vehicles, steel and aluminium - so MFN is the entire stack. The deeper difference from the US is the BASE: this 7% is charged on VALUE FOR DUTY, which is the supplier price, where the US charges its 41.4% (HTS 9405.11.80) on retail. About CA$2.04 a unit against US$40.57.
verdict: Priced at $99.29, under the RULE 2 ceiling of $103.49 (median $89.99 x 1.15) and under the $99.99 page-1 median measured separately on 2026-09-10. Contributes $57.51/unit on the binding 'prepaid' basis and $13.72 on the billed basis, both against a $12.00 floor. This is the FIRST approved offer to clear the floor on BOTH bases - hand-woven-bamboo-pendant-light sits at $11.58 billed and plug-in-bamboo-sconce-swing-arm at $7.96, so those two still depend on US_DUTY_INCIDENCE resolving to prepaid and this one does not. Top competitor review count 921, so the category is not locked. The gate is a floor, not a CPA test: measured CPA benchmarks run $31.16-$47.93 per order and $57.51 clears all three on the prepaid basis, $13.72 clears none of them on the billed basis.
